title: Proclamation Constituting the Most Erudite Benevolent Dukedom
subtitle: Twenty articles establishing the constitutional order, its epistemic realms, and the office of the Benevolent Dictator

blocks.text: The founding instrument. It proceeds from the Proclamation of Individual Equity (PoIE) v1.0 and constitutes the Dukedom as an epistemic constitutional realm rather than a claim upon any external polity. Twenty articles carry the whole architecture: the sovereignty of the individual, the recognition of distinct epistemic realms, Natural Justice as a constraint upon executable sovereign intent, PEDLER, epistemic due process, the corpus, erudition without infallibility, synthetiform participation, the House, peerage and dignities, the constitutional Act, and continuity.

blocks.explanation: Read Article VI against Article XVIII. Benevolent Dictatorship is defined as stewardship toward Individual Equity and is expressly bounded by Natural Justice — Article XVIII then names the Benevolent Dictator the first servant of the constitutional corpus. The office is constituted as a duty before it is constituted as a power, and Article III forbids reading any constitutional office as ownership of an individual.
